mode_reason: CANONICAL (operator 2026-08-22, RC-457): ONE canonical worktree total. ONE ACTIVE_WRITER at a time, selected by the operator (Claude or Cursor). No permanent coder/auditor identity. A second normal project worktree BLOCKS. Sibling -Claude trees are a second normal worktree and BLOCK. Isolated mode remains injectable for historical negative controls only. Measurement/tmp/.claude/worktrees (including check_delta_adds_no_debt TemporaryDirectory prefix deltagate-) are not normal project worktrees.
description: ONE canonical checkout. The ACTIVE_WRITER (operator-selected) mutates this tree. The non-active agent must not concurrently mutate protected paths. ED_AGENT_ROLE is still required (no silent default). Role is not bound to a -Claude path suffix.

roles.cursor: May write only when ACTIVE_WRITER=cursor. No permanent auditor or writer privilege.
roles.claude: May write only when ACTIVE_WRITER=claude. Uses the same canonical worktree. No permanent writer privilege.

fail_fast: ED_AGENT_ROLE unset or invalid → exit 1. Zero or >1 normal project worktrees → BLOCK where execution requires one canonical identity.
db: PRODUCTION canonical DB is singular: data/ed_console.db. Ambient per-agent DB forks stay banned (RC-401).
handoff: Commit or stash in the canonical worktree before the other agent reads shared HEAD. tools/check_worktree_handoff.py enforces dirty-source + role. Canonical mode does not bind Claude to a sibling tree.
